results.title: DK Shivakumar Heads to Delhi | Crucial Congress Talks Over Karnataka Cabinet Crisis | News18
results.description: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar is set to travel to Delhi at 5 p.m. today for crucial discussions with the Congress High Command, including party general secretary K.C. Venugopal.The meeting comes amid unresolved issues surrounding cabinet allocation and growing discontent among some senior MLAs within the Karnataka Congress. results.title: Nirav Modi Extradition Stalls Again, Raising India-uk Tensions
results.description: Modi’s case now carries significance beyond one fugitive businessman. Nirav Modi has lost major legal challenges against extradition to India, but the fugitive diamantaire remains in a UK prison as administrative and legal procedures continue, reviving questions over why his return has taken so long.

results.title: NPP Mion constituency Chairman resigns
results.description: The Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP) in the Mion Constituency of the Northern Region, Sulaiman Abubakar, has resigned from his position with immediate effect.

results.title: Senate Leaves for Recess Without Passing Trump’s SAVE America Act as Budget Plan Stalls
results.description: Senate Republicans departed for August recess Friday without voting on the SAVE America Act, after Trump rejected the $150 billion reconciliation package assembled by Sen. Ron Johnson. The Senate returns in mid-September with roughly four weeks before the midterm recess.

results.title: Kharge urges amplifying youth voices on Indian Youth Congress Foundation Day
results.description: On Indian Youth Congress Foundation Day, Kharge calls for amplifying youth voices and addressing their concerns for a better future in India.
